theorems.name: Submission.dimred_mbl_dt_lpip_normalized_rep
theorems.statement: (∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (S : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (ω : TestFormOn U n), Disjoint (tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n)) S.support → S ω = 0) → (∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (R : IMRep U n), IsOpen U → R.Represents T → ∀ W : Set (Euclid P), IsOpen W → T.massOn W = R.measure W) → ((∀ (P n : ℕ) (U M M' : Set (Euclid P)), IsOpen U → MeasurableSet M → MeasurableSet M' → M ⊆ M' → M' ⊆ U → (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → μHE[n] (M' ∩ K) ≠ ∞) → ∀ᵐ x ∂(μHE[n].restrict M), ∀ Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P), HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M x Q ↔ HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M' x Q) ∧ (∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (R : IMRep U n) (E : Set (Euclid P)), IsOpen U → MeasurableSet E → ∃ (A : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (R' : IMRep U n), R'.Represents A ∧ R'.carrier = R.carrier ∩ E ∧ R'.mult = R.mult ∧ R'.orient = R.orient) ∧ (∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (A B : GeometricCurrentOn U n), IsOpen U → IsIntegerMultiplicity A → IsIntegerMultiplicity B → IsIntegerMultiplicity (A - B)) ∧ (∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (R : IMRep U n), ∀ᵐ x ∂(μHE[n].restrict R.carrier), ∀ α : Covector (Euclid P) n, |R.orient x α| ≤ covectorEuclideanNorm α)) → ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (X : GeometricCurrentOn U n), IsOpen U → IsIntegerMultiplicity X → ∃ R : IMRep U n, R.Represents X ∧ R.carrier ⊆ X.support ∧ R.measure U = X.mass
